findings.issue: Hiphil active participle of bring is rendered by the nonce trayente, which is not Spanish for bringing, so the clause does not say that I bring you.
Negated hiphil imperfect is a coordinated will-not; subjunctive vomite leans jussive or purpose without a purpose particle in the tokens.

notes: 2mp futures match ustedes address; the other tokens match in number, person, and participants.
